description: LANUK, the North Rhine-Westphalia state office for nature, environment and climate, publishes renewable energy data behind its Energieatlas NRW. A WMS service shows plants for biomass, ground-mounted photovoltaics, hydropower and wind power, plus sewage gas, landfill gas and mine gas plants that aid climate protection, each split into in operation, approved and decommissioned layers. An Atom download feed offers the same data as dataset feeds for biomass, ground-mounted PV, rooftop PV, mine gas, sewage gas, hydropower, wind and landfill gas plants; its catalogue entry was modified on 22 July 2026 and states that no conditions apply. Separately, LANUK has run potential studies since 2012 for bioenergy, geothermal, industrial waste heat, combined heat and power, rooftop and ground-mounted PV, pumped storage, solar thermal, mine water heat, hydropower and wind, summarised in an Excel table released under Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 and last modified in May 2025, with full reports on the LANUK site. All parts are available as free downloads or web services. Coverage is North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Caveats: texts are in German, and the WMS abstract notes plants shown up to August 2023. Simulation uses are regional renewable plant inventories and technical potentials for capacity expansion and heat planning. Related records: data-nrw-municipal-heat-planning-data-lanuk comes from the same office.
